description.zh:
要查询的主机共享密钥的ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the shared key whose information you want to query.

> You can call the [ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~) operation to query the shared key ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 查询主机共享密钥的详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-id 10427 --region cn-hangzhou
